title: Strict integral coherence comparisons and structural evaluation
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$, a finite coefficient field $E$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension], and a family of schemes. Use the strict coefficient complexes and operations [def-pur-strict-quotient-expressions], completed expression syntax [def-pur-completed-operation-expressions] and structural generators [def-pur-completed-operation-comparison-data]. For $f:X\to Y$ a PullbackComparison is a strong monoidal structure on its termwise sequence-site inverse image, whose tensor component sends the inverse-image unit of $x\otimes y$ to the tensor of the two inverse-image units. Define Coherent to mean compatibility with the Koszul-signed cochain symmetry, and CompositionLaw to mean the tensor comparison is compatible with the adjunction-normalized inverse-image compositor for two composable maps. Define value by recursive interpretation of typed expressions on strict complexes, and structuralValue by the actual cochain associators, both action unitors, signed symmetry, inverse-image compositor, identities, inverses, composites and tensor/pullback contexts. These are constructions and predicates, without existence or coherence assertions.
